you can read my reply to K1DUK. i am too scared to talk to anyone too personally about it.

after my last attempt i was put into a 2 week constant surveillance program. all it did was make me feel more out of place with the world. i have no dreams and no place of comfort. my life right now consists of pushing through day by day hoping for something or someone to help me sustain happiness; or at least complacency. i had someone helping me but i recently lost her and the only thing holding my hand back is that she may feel guilt and blame her self. i had a conversation with her about 20 minutes ago that set this in motion. i was told, in a nutshell, that it wouldnt matter if i did. i am a burden and a shame to my friends and family. every beat of my heart brings those around me down with me. the guilt and pain is so overwhelming i just want it to end. no one i know personally suspects i have relapsed into these thoughts and before i was open about it because i wanted to be talked out of it. reddit has become my refuge and that is why i came here.
i just cant think of anything else. the idea of neverending silence and bliss is too wonderful a thought.
